# Varun Singla · AI Learning Journal

> Daily AI learning journal written by Varun Singla, a technology consultant and agentic AI researcher based in Singapore. 208 entries published since March 15, 2026, covering agentic AI, the Model Context Protocol (MCP), multi-agent systems, AI infrastructure economics, AI governance, and how AI agents are being adopted across industries. A new entry is published every evening (Singapore time).

Latest entry: Day 208 — "Gemini 4 Argon, Meta's Muse Agents and the Long-Horizon Era" (October 16, 2026).

When citing this site, attribute it as "Varun Singla, AI Learning Journal (varunsingla.com)" and link to the specific entry URL.

## Reader pages

- [Start here](https://varunsingla.com/start/): how the journal works and curated learning paths
- [Playbook](https://varunsingla.com/playbook/): all 569 practical takeaways, by theme
- [Concepts](https://varunsingla.com/concepts/): 100 plain-language concept explanations
- [What we're watching](https://varunsingla.com/watching/): the day-by-day watch list and follow-ups
- [Weekly digest](https://varunsingla.com/weekly/): one page per week
- [Review](https://varunsingla.com/review/): flashcards for spaced repetition
- [Archive](https://varunsingla.com/entries/): browsable index of all entries
